rachats.citation: On September 1, 2021, we acquired certain assets and operations of CTF Holdings Limited Partnership (“CTF”) for a purchase price of $ 182.5 million, net of cash acquired.
On July 1, 2021, we acquired all of the operating affiliates of Cornerstone Building Alliance SW, LLC (“Alliance”) for a purchase price of, $ 408.9 million, net of cash acquired.

On August 16, 2021, we acquired certain assets and operations of WTS Paradigm, LLC (“Paradigm”), a software solutions and services provider for the building products industry for a purchase price of $ 449.6 million, net of cash acquired.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
